description: Supported leagues are NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, MLS, NCAAF and FIFA. For an explicitly unsupported league such as CFL, NLL, WNBA, F1 or UFC, explain the limit without making a tool call; do not substitute a supported league. Find individual sporting events, including one game or multiple games from one league, using SportCation. Never force a second game or sport. Search with start_date and end_date (at most 31 inclusive dates within 180 days), optional city, leagues, team, opponent and team_role; both teams must occur in the same game. Use canonical city/team slugs. Return at most 10 events, ordered by local date/start; unknown times remain TBD/unavailable. For an exact selected game, pass only event_id and optionally include_hotel, with no search filters. Revalidate the same game without substitutions. Ticket estimates come from SportCation in USD for two adults with Standard seating; per_person is one ticket estimate. Report its basis as a stored listing snapshot or modeled/representative average; Standard is a calculator assumption, not a verified seat location. Hotel is excluded unless the user explicitly requests a stay and include_hotel=true. hotel_estimate_requested=false with price_estimate=null means the hotel-inclusive estimate was not requested; report any available ticket_estimate and never call ticket pricing unavailable for that reason. Use limit=1 when the user asks for one event or the next game. Unknown home/away/neutral roles are not guessed; excluded role records and capped results are not evidence of real-world absence. No live quotes, inventory or booking. Copy returned itinerary links verbatim. For requests for examples or whether trips exist, apply the named-team and league requirements and present about three suitable options once found, stating the searched dates. Do not scan the full 180 days by default or rescan solely because a result cap was reached. Refine when requirements remain unmet or the user requests broader coverage. Never claim exhaustive coverage from capped results or narrower follow-up filters. Empty truncated results are inconclusive. For weekend requests, flag Monday games as requiring an extra day; describe a holiday extension only when applicable.

limit.description: Use 1 for a next-game or one-event request; use up to 5 for an initial event list. Default 5, maximum 10.

name: find_sporting_events

hotel_estimate_requested.description: False means no hotel estimate was requested. In that case a null price_estimate does not mean ticket pricing is unavailable; use ticket_estimate for the event price.

itinerary_url.description: SportCation itinerary for this event only. Copy the complete returned URL verbatim, including attribution parameters.

nights.description: Zero only when the estimate is unavailable and no stay assumptions could be resolved.

price_estimate.description: Optional SportCation ticket-and-hotel planning estimate, requested with include_hotel=true. Null when hotel_estimate_requested=false means not requested, not that the available ticket_estimate is missing. Never assume a hotel for a single-event question.

seat_tier.description: Calculator planning assumption only; this is not a verified seat location or listing tier.

ticket_estimate.description: SportCation ticket-only planning estimate in USD; per-person and two-adult totals. A null or unavailable estimate is not a price or availability guarantee.
